entities.name: Query Ham1p-like protein
observations: 208 aa protein with a Pfam Ham1p_like domain (PF01725.22) spanning residues 3–203.
Best curated homologs show 40.7–44.0% identity over essentially the full sequence, supporting assignment as a dITP/XTP pyrophosphatase.
Sequence-based assignment has moderate homology support; exact substrate preference remains inferred rather than experimentally demonstrated for this sequence.

entities.name: B9L638
observations: Reviewed UniProt homolog from Nautilia profundicola annotated as dITP/XTP pyrophosphatase, EC 3.6.1.66.
Catalyzes hydrolysis of noncanonical purine nucleoside triphosphates, especially XTP, dITP, and ITP, to monophosphate products and diphosphate.
Binds one Mg2+ ion per subunit and forms a homodimer.
